title: Pure Dragonmaid
summary: Dragonmaid cards only, with generic staples. Each small maid searches, mills or revives when summoned and swaps into her Dragon form at the start of the Battle Phase, and each Dragon swaps back at the end of it, so the board changes shape every turn. The 2025 cards lead. Dragonmaid Cehrmba discards itself to revive a Dragonmaid from the GY or banishment and keeps your Dragon Fusions safe from the opponent's effects. Lady's Dragonmaid is a Contact Fusion from two Dragonmaids of the same Attribute; it summons a small maid from the Deck and Fusion Summons House Dragonmaid or Sheou in each Standby Phase by shuffling materials back. Dragonmaid Sheou negates on either turn and turns into House Dragonmaid.
